title: Flashy codebase layout reference
content:
Flashy v0.1.0 - Python-based agentic coding CLI. Started Jan 14 2026, 91 commits.
Entry: cli.py (argparse) + run.py + __main__.py. Interactive chat: backend/cli_chat.py using rich/questionary/prompt_toolkit.
Backend: FastAPI app (backend/app.py) with 16 routers, 33+ providers in backend/providers/, 7 specialized agents in backend/agents/ (Orchestrator, Architect, Developer, Reviewer, Researcher, Explorer, Learner), tool system in backend/tooling/ (filesystem, shell, git, web, collaboration).
LLMService in backend/llm_runtime/service.py with agent loop (max_iter=500), context compaction, native tool calls, JSON/XML tool parsing.
Desktop: Tauri shell (src-tauri/) + PyInstaller sidecar. Per-launch Basic Auth on 127.0.0.1.
Storage: JSON files in user data dir (atomic writes with tempfile+rename), file locks.
Frontend: vanilla JS, 61KB index.html, 12+ JS modules, 12 CSS modules. WebSocket chat.
Tests: NONE (no tests/ dir, no pytest config, no CI for tests - only release.yml).
Docs: AUDIT_REPORT.md, CONTINUITY.md, DESKTOP.md, PRODUCTION_PASS.md - no README.md.
CLI commands today: serve, server, status, stop, config, chat, version. Slash cmds in chat: /clear, /model, /compact, /thinking, exit/quit.

title: Flashy CLI Production Pass
content:
## Goal
Bring flashy-cli from a working but rough tool to a serious, reliable AI coding CLI that competes with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI.

## Approach
- Don't overcomplicate. Don't add heavy security/policy/sandbox stuff.
- Focus on UX, reliability, useful commands, and a polished interactive experience.
- Split the 700-line cli_chat.py into smaller modules.
- Add new features that matter: session resume, file references, better streaming, theme picker, shell completions.
- Keep things lean and fast.

## Key Deliverables
1. Theme/color system with NO_COLOR, theme picker
2. Better streaming output: spinner, tool progress, token usage in real-time
3. Multi-line input (Esc+Enter for newlines)
4. @file references in prompts
5. Session persistence: /sessions, /resume, /save
6. New commands: init, resume, sessions, completion, theme, stats, login, review
7. Better diagnostics: faster, more actionable
8. Better error messages with suggested fixes
9. More tests
10. Updated docs

## Files I'll create/modify
NEW:
- flashy_cli/theme.py
- flashy_cli/output.py (rich output rendering)
- flashy_cli/prompt.py (multi-line prompt)
- flashy_cli/banner.py
- flashy_cli/sessions.py
- flashy_cli/format/markdown.py
- flashy_cli/format/diff.py
- flashy_cli/commands/* (split command logic)
- flashy_cli/commands/chat.py (refactored chat)
- tests/test_format.py
- tests/test_sessions.py
- tests/test_prompt.py

MODIFY:
- flashy_cli/app.py (add new commands, better error handling)
- flashy_cli/ui.py (refined)
- flashy_cli/doctor.py (better)
- flashy_cli/runtime.py (small additions)
- backend/cli_chat.py (or remove if fully replaced)
- README.md (or add new docs)
- setup.py (add new entry)
